about.title: About
about.description:
React, Next.js, Node.js and TypeScript developer focused on building modern, performant and maintainable web interfaces.
I mainly contribute on front-end topics, with strong attention to execution quality, journey clarity and product consistency.

My work is grounded in real projects designed to solve concrete needs and create visible impact for both users and the business.
Outside of development, I stay curious through sports, music and creative environments.

profile.heading: A fast, structured and product-minded contribution
profile.intro: I contribute best in environments where an interface needs to be designed, structured and pushed forward with high standards, while keeping business needs and product priorities clearly in view.

screens.title: Interfaces & flows
screens.desc: Designing clear, well-structured screens that make journeys easier to understand and smoother to use across desktop and mobile.

components.title: UI systems & components
components.desc: Setting up reusable components, a consistent UI foundation and simple conventions to speed up delivery without lowering quality.

backend.title: Front-end / API integration
backend.desc: Connecting interfaces to APIs and real use cases, with a clear and pragmatic Node.js layer when the project needs it.

finish.title: Execution quality
finish.desc: Finishing the details that strengthen product perception: responsive behavior, accessibility, performance, reading comfort and visual consistency.

method.heading: A clear, reliable and delivery-focused approach

understand.title: Frame the need
understand.desc: Clarify the problem to solve, the users involved and the functional priorities so the work starts on the right foundation.

usage.title: Clarify the experience
usage.desc: Shape information hierarchy, reading rhythm and interactions so the product feels more intuitive and efficient to use.

foundation.title: Build a solid foundation
foundation.desc: Create a clean front-end structure, useful components and readable technical integration that support long-term product evolution.

finish.title: Deliver with care
finish.desc: Validate the details that matter in production: responsive behavior, keyboard support, performance, visual consistency and robust integration.

footer.tagline: Building clean, performant and user-centered web interfaces.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains how personal data is handled when you use this portfolio.

dataCollected.title: Data collected
dataCollected.paragraphs:
When you use the messaging feature, the temporary username and messages you submit are processed so the conversation can be created and continued.

The technical IP address may be processed temporarily to protect the service against abuse and apply rate limits. The selected theme is stored locally in your browser and is not sent to the publisher.

purposesAndRecipients.title: Purposes and recipients
purposesAndRecipients.paragraphs: Data is used to provide the requested contact or messaging service, maintain security and respond to your requests. Messaging data may be stored with Supabase as the service provider. It is not sold or used for advertising.

retentionAndRights.title: Retention and rights
retentionAndRights.paragraphs:
Data is retained only for as long as necessary to manage the conversation and meet applicable legal obligations. You may request access, correction or deletion of your data by contacting ronanchenu.dev@gmail.com.

You may also lodge a complaint with the data protection authority in your country, including the CNIL in France.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: This portfolio does not use advertising cookies or audience measurement cookies.

necessaryCookie.title: Strictly necessary cookie
necessaryCookie.paragraphs:
When you start a conversation, the site may set the httpOnly cookie portfolio-messaging-resume for up to 30 days. It contains a technical resume token so the conversation can be continued from the same browser.

This cookie is used only for the messaging feature requested by the visitor and is not used for advertising or tracking.

localStorage.title: Local storage
localStorage.paragraphs: The selected light or dark theme and, where applicable, the messaging resume token are stored in your browser's local storage. These items are used to preserve the site's functionality and preferences; they are not sent to advertising services.

managingChoices.title: Managing your choices
managingChoices.paragraphs: You can delete cookies and local storage data from your browser settings. Blocking the messaging cookie or local storage may prevent the conversation from being resumed.
